description: Training providers, language schools, coaching institutes, e-learning providers, tutoring
typical_workflows: Course planning: Curriculum development, scheduling, instructor coordination
Content creation: Training materials, presentations, e-learning modules
Delivery: In-person or online training sessions
Marketing: Course marketing, social media, email campaigns
common_pain_points: Content creation time-consuming: 10-20h per training day
Individualization difficult: Different participant skill levels
Manual feedback evaluation: Many forms to analyze manually
Creating certificates: Fill out and send each individually
Marketing content: Regularly new course descriptions needed
ai_opportunities: Generate training materials: Topic → Presentation + Handout
Quiz/Test creation: Automatic exam questions from content
Personalized learning: Individual learning paths based on level
Feedback analysis: Automatically analyze evaluation forms
Course descriptions: Marketing texts for new courses
Chatbot for participants: FAQs, course info, registration help
Translations: Course material into multiple languages
Automate certificates: Mass generation of personalized PDFs
typical_tools: Excel for participant lists and planning
